name: How do real estate agents help sell homes without repairs?

mainEntity.name: How do real estate agents help sell homes without repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Real estate agents specialize in navigating the complexities of selling homes, especially those marketed 'as-is.' Kelby Contreras and Realty ONE Group Evolution can help by accurately pricing your property to attract the right buyers who are looking for homes needing work. They market the property effectively, highlighting its potential while transparently disclosing its current condition. Agents also manage negotiations, helping you secure the best possible offer despite the need for repairs. Their expertise in handling offers, counteroffers, and buyer concerns ensures a smoother transaction, ultimately guiding you through the entire process from listing to closing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Agents help by pricing, marketing, and negotiating as-is properties, ensuring a smoother transaction despite needed repairs.
